modern: Augustus’ court, wife, daughter, descendants, ancestors, sister, Agrippa, kinsmen, intimates, friends; Areius, Maecenas, physicians, and sacrificing priests—the whole court is dead. Then turn to the rest, considering not the death of a single man but of a whole family, as of the Pompeii; and what is inscribed on the tombs—The last of his line. Then consider what trouble those before them took so that they might leave a successor; and then, that of necessity someone must be the last. Again, here consider the death of a whole family.
original: Augustus’ court, wife, daughter, descendants, ancestors, sister, Agrippa, kinsmen, intimates, friends; Areius, Maecenas, physicians, and sacrificing priests,—the whole court is dead. Then turn to the rest, not considering the death of a single man [but of a whole race], as of the Pompeii; and that which is inscribed on the tombs,—The last of his race. Then consider what trouble those before them have had that they might leave a successor; and then, that of necessity some one must be the last. Again, here consider the death of a whole race.
